newsitem.title: UK: LucasVarity sells unit to DT Industries.
newsitem.headline: LucasVarity sells unit to DT Industries.

text.p: Anglo-American engineering giant LucasVarity Plc said on Tuesday it sold its Lucas Assembly and Test Systems (LATS) unit to U.S. group DT Industries Inc for 30 million stg cash.
The unit, which makes assembly line equipment for the car industry, had pre-tax profits of 3.0 million stg before exceptionals on sales of 69 million stg in the year ended on January 31.
The company said the price paid was subject to a final closing balance sheet adjustment.
LATS was one of the 13 businesses LucasVarity earmarked for sale in December 1996.
Proceeds from the four businesses sold since then, including LATS, totalled about 40 million stg.
LucasVarity said it expected the sale of the other nine businesses to be substantially completed by the end of this financial year. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
